items.name: velobits
items.title: VeloBits
items.description: The base style: tokens, the cn util, the provider stack, and every Tier-1 primitive, Tier-2 overlay and Tier-3 composite. Start here.

items.name: velobits-theme
items.title: VeloBits theme
items.description: The full token layer as CSS variables. Every colour pair here is contrast-verified in both themes by the @velobits-dev/tokens test suite.

items.name: cn
items.title: cn
items.description: Tailwind-aware class merger. Signature must stay twMerge(clsx(...)) — the dashboard app points components.json `utils` at it.

items.name: theme
items.title: Theme resolution
items.description: React-free light/dark resolution, storage and the blocking init script. Storage key is required, never defaulted.

items.name: use-theme
items.title: useTheme
items.description: ThemeProvider + useTheme. Honours the existing fmx_theme_mode and tf.theme keys.

items.name: use-media-query
items.title: useMediaQuery
items.description: Media query subscription plus usePrefersReducedMotion. Import breakpoints from @velobits-dev/tokens rather than re-typing the pixel value, so the JS and CSS breakpoints cannot drift apart.

items.name: use-row-selection
items.title: useRowSelection
items.description: Row selection for DataTable. The selection is DERIVED — the stored set intersected with the rows on screen — so a bulk action can never point at a row the filter has hidden. Returns a stable object identity, which is what keeps DataTable’s memoised rows from re-rendering per keystroke.

items.name: velobits-provider
items.title: VelobitsProvider
items.description: Mount once at the shell root: ThemeProvider + TooltipProvider + MotionConfig reducedMotion="user".

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Status panel. Defaults to polite role="status"; escalate to "alert" deliberately. Tier-S glass on the neutral variant only — the four soft washes would replace the tint.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Soft washes pair with the matching text token, never with the solid fill.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Controls are radius-md. No variant paints --primary as text; `link` uses --primary-text.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Tier-S glass by default; surface="panel" for the opaque original, which writes border-border explicitly so it survives an app that skipped the base layer.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Includes the indeterminate state bulk-selection headers need.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Label/description/error wiring. Keeps BOTH ids in aria-describedby when a field has an error and a hint.

items.name: glass-surface
items.title: GlassSurface
items.description: All three glass tiers behind one prop: surface (Tier S, no blur by default) · overlay · elevated. Never for page backgrounds, table rows, or nested glass.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: border-input maps to --field-border, the half WCAG 1.4.11 gates.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: A real <label>, so htmlFor resolves. Non-control roots need aria-labelledby instead.

items.name: native-select
items.title: NativeSelect
items.description: A cva-styled native <select>. Deliberately NOT Radix Select, which is undriveable under happy-dom.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: Decorative, so it uses --border and is exempt from 1.4.11.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: aria-hidden; pair with ONE sr-only live region rather than announcing each block.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Applies immediately. Thumb translation is mirrored explicitly for RTL.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: TooltipProvider is required — Radix throws without it, and under Module Federation it must be a singleton.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: CommandPalette
items.description: cmdk inside a Radix Dialog. The ⌘K listener is opt-in via `shortcut` — a design system must not bind a global key by merely being imported.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: The centred form modal. `focusFirstField` exists because autoFocus is silently swallowed by Radix FocusScope.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: DropdownMenu
items.description: Highlight is data-[highlighted], never :hover — Radix drives keyboard focus through it. Cannot host a text input; use Dialog or Popover.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: The elevated tier, for glass stacked on glass. PopoverTitle wires aria-labelledby — Radix content is role="dialog" with no Title part, so it is otherwise unnamed.

items.name: side-panel
items.title: SidePanel
items.description: The anchored reading sheet. Deliberately NOT Dialog and deliberately does NOT redirect focus — the two focus policies are opposites, so do not merge them behind a `side` variant. The bottom variant needs a definite 75dvh.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Variants use a logical border stripe, not a soft wash: bg-*-soft is a utility and beats --glass-bg from the components layer, flattening the tier.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: The one sanctioned height animation: Radix measures --radix-accordion-content-height, so it does not thrash layout the way an unbounded height:auto transition would.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: AppShell
items.description: The authenticated chrome. `sidebar` is a prop rather than a child because it is rendered TWICE — as a rail at md and up, and inside a drawer below it — so a nav item cannot exist in one and not the other. Ships the skip link, which is the most-skipped WCAG requirement in an admin UI.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: A named nav landmark around an ordered list. The leaf is a plain span with aria-current="page" — NOT shadcn’s role="link" aria-disabled, which announces static text as a broken link.

items.name: code-block
items.title: CodeBlock
items.description: Preformatted code, with a copy button that survives an insecure origin (navigator.clipboard is absent over plain http). The `terminal` variant is the theme-invariant --code/--on-code pair, which is what a one-time secret is revealed on.

items.name: data-table
items.title: DataTable
items.description: Sorting, selection and row activation over a column registry — deliberately not TanStack, whose grouping and pivoting nothing here uses. aria-sort goes on the th, not the sort button, and an activatable row needs tabIndex + Enter/Space + a target check or it is mouse-only.

items.name: diff-viewer
items.title: DiffViewer
items.description: A unified line diff. The +/− gutter is the primary channel and the green/red wash the secondary — colour alone fails 1.4.1, and the gutter is also the only channel that survives greyscale. Ships `diffLines`, with a guard: LCS is O(n·m) in MEMORY.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: EmptyState
items.description:
First-run, filtered-to-nothing and failed-to-load are three different states; this covers the first two and an Alert covers the third. The title is a

unless headingLevel is set, because an empty state usually sits inside a container that already has the heading.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: react-hook-form bound to Field’s ARIA wiring. label and description are PROPS, not children, because aria-describedby is assembled before children render — a description left out while its id is still listed is a dangling reference. NOT exported from the npm barrel: react-hook-form is an optional peer.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Numbers are links, previous/next are buttons: an <a> cannot express "unavailable" without ceasing to be focusable. Unavailability is aria-disabled plus a guard, so focus is not lost at the ends of the range. `paginationRange` returns a CONSTANT number of slots so the control never reflows as you page.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: SegmentedControl
items.description: Radix ToggleGroup with a REAL disabled and a working accessible name — a div root makes an external htmlFor dangle, and pointer-events-none leaves the control focusable and unannounced.

items.name: status-chip
items.title: StatusChip
items.description: On/off/partial/pending/archived as one chip. Every status ships a DISTINCT glyph, because colour alone fails 1.4.1 and on-versus-off is the distinction a control plane exists to make unambiguous. Composes Badge rather than re-deriving the soft-wash pairs.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Rows are never glass — one backdrop-filter per row repaints its own backdrop region on every scroll. Surface treatment belongs on the container.
